subject.title: refactor(qa): remove execution and Matrix profiles

question: Should legacy trailing `openclaw qa matrix --profile <former-matrix-profile>` invocations fail with migration guidance, or should the repository intentionally accept their new global-root-profile meaning despite the changed Matrix selection?
rationale: The PR deliberately retires Matrix profiles while retaining a root `--profile` flag, so the same token now has a different owner and can silently broaden an established QA command. This is a compatibility policy choice, not merely a mechanical refactor.

options.title: Fail fast for retired Matrix profiles
options.body: Detect the legacy Matrix-local form and explain that normal Matrix runs select all eligible scenarios and subsets use repeated `--scenario`.

options.title: Accept the new global interpretation
options.body: Document that trailing `--profile` now configures the root state profile and accept that former Matrix-focused invocations may run the full eligible suite.

options.title: Add a short deprecation bridge
options.body: Temporarily recognize former Matrix profile names only to emit a deprecation warning and migration guidance before removing them on a stated schedule.

recommendation.title: Fail fast for retired Matrix profiles
recommendation.body: Detect the legacy Matrix-local form and explain that normal Matrix runs select all eligible scenarios and subsets use repeated `--scenario`.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor authored the complete QA selection series and the final change that removes the Matrix parser exception.
